_comment: task-48 FROZEN golden vectors for the RawNarV1 addressed unit. RawNarV1 is the exact `nix-store --dump <path>` byte stream (uncompressed NAR); the addressed unit is BLAKE3(RawNarV1) with NO domain separation. This file is the single source of truth for the golden values: `daemon/tests/golden_vectors.rs` checks the ENCODINGS are canonical (no fixture needed, runs in the Nix sandbox), and `scripts/check-golden-vectors.py` RE-DERIVES them from the regenerated fixture and asserts they match byte-for-byte. Changing any value here is a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze.
recipe: plain unkeyed BLAKE3 over the exact `nix-store --dump` bytes; no domain separation; canonical string form blake3:<64 lowercase hex chars>

recipe_vectors.note: the published BLAKE3 empty-input vector; a keyed or domain-separated recipe cannot produce it
a fixed non-empty marker, cross-checked against a stock b3sum

fixture.note: the `lib` fixture path; compression=none, so its served .nar IS the raw NAR (== nix-store --dump). Belongs to workload nix-p2p-fixture-workload-v1, which is pinned reproducible, so this digest is stable until the workload is deliberately bumped.
